definitions.explanation: A humble word for going to see someone of higher status. Today it is mostly old-fashioned or used playfully, as in a hero's or a performer's "Here I am!"

examples.japanese: ⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧{参上|さんじょう}！
⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧、{御礼|おれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{参上|さんじょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will call on you tomorrow to express my thanks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正義|せいぎ}→正義：05097_seigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味方|みかた}→味方：03743_mikata⟧、{参上|さんじょう}！⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{叫|さけ}んで→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んで→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧きた。
examples.english: Shouting "Champion of justice, at your service!", the child burst into the room.

notes:
{参|さん} (go, humble) + ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (up, to a superior). A humble verb of going, like ⟦{参|まい}る→参る：01322_mairu⟧ and {伺|うかが}う, but stiffer and more old-fashioned.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参上|さんじょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧: I will come to you (very humble)
- 〜、{参上|さんじょう}！: X has arrived! (a hero's or show's entrance line)
- {急|きゅう}いで{参上|さんじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hurry over

REGISTER:
In real business Japanese, {伺|うかが}います or ⟦{参|まい}ります→参る：01322_mairu⟧ is normal; {参上|さんじょう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧ sounds theatrical today. Its liveliest use is the jokey entrance line from period dramas and hero shows.
